bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
py="$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
"$py" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health || exit 71
git -C "$r" show fb6678b24dfad4f0f204699ddbf5109c729fe3aa:scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py | cmp -s - "$r/scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py" || exit 72
old_inode=$(stat -c %i "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")
git -C "$r" fetch -q origin fix/room-public-userbot-position-choice-20261113
test "$(git -C "$r" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 0278e7fe7da24f1c9d18a8ad3b5710da987f3afc || exit 73
tmp=$(mktemp "$r/scripts/.room_public_smoke.XXXXXX")
git -C "$r" show FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py > "$tmp"
python3 -B - "$tmp" <<'PY'
import ast,sys
ast.parse(open(sys.argv[1],encoding='utf8').read())
PY
backup=$(mktemp "$r/scripts/.room_public_smoke_backup.XXXXXX")
cp -p "$r/scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py" "$backup"
chmod 644 "$tmp"
mv "$tmp" "$r/scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py"
if ! systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service; then cp -p "$backup" "$r/scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py"; systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || :; exit 74; fi
ready=no
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
 if test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active && "$py" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=yes; break; fi
 sleep 1
done
if test "$ready" != yes; then cp -p "$backup" "$r/scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py"; systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || :; exit 75; fi
test "$(stat -c %i "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")" = "$old_inode" || exit 76
test "$(stat -c %a "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")" = 600 || exit 77
echo ROOM_PUBLIC_TEST_POSITION_CHOICE_ACTIVATED=PASS
echo USERBOT_SESSION_PRESERVED=PASS
